story_summary: Constrain department field to a fixed list in Employee Directory (add/edit)

requirements.notes: File is named requirement.md (singular), not the pipeline default requirements.md, per explicit user instruction. Later phases should reference requirement.md.

architecture.notes: New ui/src/constants/departments.js; select-based dropdowns in EmployeeDirectory.jsx and EmployeeRow.jsx; no API/store changes. Revised in e446f6e per design-review.

design-review.notes: 3 findings, all fixed: blank placeholder option to preserve optional department; existing tests need query-by-accessible-name update; aria-label="Department" added to both selects.

impl-plan.notes: 6 tasks: create ui/src/constants/departments.js; convert EmployeeDirectory.jsx and EmployeeRow.jsx department fields to <select aria-label="Department">; fix EmployeeRow.test.jsx query (getByPlaceholderText -> getByRole('combobox', {name})); add FR-5 out-of-list coverage test; verify EmployeeDirectory.test.jsx needs no change.

implementation.notes: All 6 impl-plan tasks done: departments.js created; EmployeeDirectory.jsx and EmployeeRow.jsx converted to <select aria-label="Department">; EmployeeRow.jsx fallback option for out-of-list values; EmployeeRow.test.jsx query fixed + new out-of-list test added. Ran `npm test` in ui/: 15/15 passed (2 files), including EmployeeDirectory.test.jsx unmodified as predicted.

code-review.notes: Verdict: approved. 2 low-risk findings (no dedicated blank-department test; small DEPARTMENTS-option-list duplication across EmployeeDirectory.jsx/EmployeeRow.jsx) both accepted as-is by requester, no follow-ups owed.

verify.notes: API suite: 13/13 passed (api/, npm test). UI suite: 15/15 passed (ui/, npm test -- --run). No browser-automation tool available in this environment, so no literal interactive click-through was performed; substituted an API-level round-trip check against an already-running local dev server (port 4000) covering blank -> fixed-list -> out-of-list (FR-5) department transitions, all persisted correctly, then cleaned up. Select rendering/interaction itself is covered by the passing RTL suite (userEvent.selectOptions in jsdom). No new findings; no code changes.

pr.notes: PR_DESCRIPTION.md overwritten for this story; CHANGELOG.md Unreleased section updated. Docs only, no app code changed. Orchestrator has no push/gh access -- branch feature/EPMCDMETST-60862-department-fixed-list handed back to the user to push and open the PR.
